Aurelion
AlignmentNeutral good
PortfolioDawn, renewal, travellers
PantheonThe Bright Circle
SymbolA rising sun over a road
WeaponSpear

Aurelion is the god of the dawn, worshipped by farmers and travellers who set out at first light.

Shrines to Aurelion stand at crossroads, each with an eastern window so that the first light of the day falls on the altar.

Dogma

Every dawn is a second chance. Help those on the road, and never turn a traveller from your door.

Worshippers

  • Farmers
  • Pilgrims
  • Caravan guards
